# Matteo Arellano

> Technical Growth Partner. Matteo Arellano helps companies grow revenue and lower cost through five services: growth marketing (SEO, generative engine optimisation, paid ads and GA4), data engineering and automation, product improvement, business development and technical sales, and payment solutions. He combines a background in finance, data engineering and analytics with hands-on product, marketing and payments work. His deepest product experience is in travel tech and ground transportation. He works in seven languages and has lived in the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Spain and Mexico.

Selected results: a 42% conversion improvement on a digital customer journey; roughly 90% lower cloud-processing cost after a pipeline redesign; more than 30 analytical models built for management decisions; card approval raised from roughly 57% to 75% (+18 percentage points) after payment-risk and authentication changes.

Confidentiality: client names, markets and figures are never published. Product research case studies use hypothetical companies and numbers; the thinking and patterns come from real work.

## Services
- [Growth Marketing: SEO, GEO, paid ads and GA4](https://matteoarellano.com/services/growth-marketing/): wins qualified demand from search, AI answers and Google Ads, and measures every channel against leads and revenue.
- [Data Engineering & Automation](https://matteoarellano.com/services/data-engineering-automation/): builds data pipelines, analyses large datasets with Python, SQL and BigQuery, and automates recurring work.
- [Product Improvement](https://matteoarellano.com/services/product-improvement/): finds where users drop off using Amplitude, GA4, BigQuery and user research, then ships and tests the fix with product and engineering teams.
- [Business Development & Technical Sales](https://matteoarellano.com/services/business-development/): helps companies enter new markets, build partnerships, prospect and close deals that need technical credibility.
- [Payment Solutions](https://matteoarellano.com/payment-solutions/): improves payment acceptance, PSP integrations, routing, 3DS and local payment methods across Latin America, the Middle East and North Africa, and Europe.
- [All services](https://matteoarellano.com/services/)

## Free tools
- [Chrome extensions](https://matteoarellano.com/chrome-extensions/): three free Chrome extensions that run locally with no account. SEO Page Audit checks a page's SEO, structure and technical basics; Link Page Checker for SEO lists every link on a page, checks HTTPS status and exports a CSV; MapSnap CSV captures Google Maps listing details into rows and exports them as CSV.
